title: Base-change target coordinates and the constant-coefficient restriction square
statement: Let k and K be fields with a k-algebra structure on K, let I be a finite type, let f:C -> Spec k, and let D_i be schemes with structure morphisms g_i and coprojections iota_i:D_i -> C whose composites with f equal g_i. Suppose C with the iota_i is a coproduct [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. For n,q natural numbers use the constant Z/n sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] and canonical cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Write p:C_K -> C and p_i:(D_i)_K -> D_i for the first projections. There is an equivalence eK from H^q(C_K,p^*Z/n_C) to the product of H^q((D_i)_K,p_i^*Z/n_D_i). For each x and i, the i-coordinate of eK(p^*x) equals p_i^* of the normalized restriction of x along iota_i, where normalization is Sheaf.H.map of the canonical inverse-image constant-sheaf isomorphism. No comparison bijectivity, smoothness, connectedness, algebraic closure or invertibility is assumed; n=0, n=1, q=0 and an empty index type are included.

source.place: First step: finite clopen component reduction; Base-change target coordinates and the constant-coefficient restriction square

proof.text: Construct each base-changed coprojection a_i by pullback.lift from p_i followed by iota_i and the second pullback projection. Its first projection identity follows from pullback.lift_fst. IsPullback.of_right applied to the two defining pullback squares shows that a_i is the pullback of iota_i. Apply Mathlib FinitaryPreExtensive.isUniversal_finiteCoproducts to hc, using the scheme FinitaryExtensive instance and the discrete natural transformation of first projections, to obtain the base-changed colimit. No clopen-image argument or scheme-coproduct-family theorem is required.

Apply finiteCoproductCohomologyAssembly to the constructed base-changed colimit and p-star F, where F is the constant Z/n sheaf. Equiv.ofBijective realizes its restriction map as an equivalence. For each coordinate compose the inverse of upperStarComp(a_i,p), eqToIso of the first projection identity, upperStarComp(p_i,iota_i), and p_i-star of the constant-sheaf comparison. Sheaf.H.map of an isomorphism is an equivalence with inverse Sheaf.H.map of its inverse, by H.map_comp_apply and H.map_id_apply. Compose the product of these explicitly constructed equivalences with the assembly equivalence. All data come from constructions or from bijectivity, which uniquely determines the inverse.

For each x and i, use cohomologyPullbackFunctorial for (a_i,p). Combine the two H.map operations with H.map_comp_apply and cancel upperStarComp with its inverse. Transport cohomologyMap across the first-projection equality using equality induction (private cohomologyMap_congr). Apply cohomologyPullbackFunctorial for (p_i,iota_i), then cohomologyMap_map for the constant-sheaf isomorphism. This is exactly the stated coordinate formula. No separate constantPullbackCompositionCoherence invocation is needed: cohomologyPullbackFunctorial already provides the required normalized composition identity.

proof_origin.place: Finite component reduction, formalized by G2 using universal finite coproducts of schemes, explicit coefficient isomorphisms, and existing cohomology pullback functoriality.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoproductConstantBaseChangeSquare
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {I : Type u} [Finite I] {C : Scheme.{u}} (D : I → Scheme.{u})
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) (g : ∀ i, D i ⟶ Spec (.of k))
    (ι : ∀ i, D i ⟶ C) (hw : ∀ i, ι i ≫ f = g i)
    (hc : IsColimit (Cofan.mk C ι)) (n q : ℕ) :
    ∃ eK : Sheaf.H
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj
          (C.constantZMod n)) q ≃
      ∀ i, Sheaf.H
        ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (pullback.fst (g i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))).obj
            ((D i).constantZMod n)) q,
    ∀ (x : Sheaf.H (C.constantZMod n) q) (i : I),
      eK (cohomologyMap
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
        (C.constantZMod n) q x) i =
      cohomologyMap
        (pullback.fst (g i) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))))
        ((D i).constantZMod n) q
        (Sheaf.H.map
          ((Scheme.upperStarConstantSheafIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (ι i)).hom.app
            (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))) q
          (cohomologyMap (ι i) (C.constantZMod n) q x))
